title: Training for Service Staff at Telecommunications Companies to Spot Possible Scams Targeted at Customers from Vulnerable Groups
what_it_is: Training for Service Staff at Telecommunications Companies to Spot Possible Scams Targeted at Customers from Vulnerable Groups

sections.label: Telco safeguards and digital literacy
sections.summary: Telcos must verify identity and explain contract terms, while MCI and agency programmes build digital literacy and cyber safety for seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister fo r Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Examples include requiring telco service staff to verify consumers' identity during the registration process, explain key contractual terms and conditions to consumers at the point of sign up and ensure that these are understood before service sign up.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister fo r Communications and Information)
sentences.text: In addition to regulatory safeguards, the Ministry of Communications and Information (MCI)'s public education programmes help to ensure that Singaporeans are equipped with digital literacy skills and can safeguard themselves against online harm and threats.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister fo r Communications and Information)
sentences.text: This includes the SG Digital Office's, Seniors Go Digital Programme and the Cyber Security Agency's SG Cyber Safe Seniors Programme, which aims to raise seniors' awareness of cybersecurity and cybercrime and encourage the adoption of good cyber hygiene practices.

sections.label: Scam bills waived by IMDA
sections.summary: A person signed four lines in a week; scammers took the phones, but IMDA intervened and the bills were waived.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Within the span of one week, he signed up for four lines and various phone contracts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: The scammers made off with the phones, the family saddled with tens of thousands of dollars of bills, but thanks to IMDA's swift intervention – I thank the colleagues at IMDA – they intervened and the bills were waived.

sections.label: IMDA telco scam response review
sections.summary: IMDA contacted telcos, who waived or froze charges; a Police report was made and telco practices and staff training will be reviewed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: In fact, for this case, when the IMDA team knew about the appeal from Mr Zhulkarnain, they immediately contacted the telco staff and within a couple of days, the telcos agreed to waive or freeze the charges and we got back to the family very soon, because we know the anxieties and the concerns of the parents, the family members and the individual himself.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: As I understand it, a Police report has been made over the case, and Police investigations are ongoing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: But the broader point that Mr Zhulkarnain has raised is something that we are continually looking into.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We will work together with our telcos, especially their frontline staff, to review their practices and whether additional staff training may be needed, so that they can flag out some of these possible scams and tactics being used against the vulnerable members of our community and see what ways we can improve the telcos themselves.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: They are, also – in a way, a victim of this crime – defrauded by some of these scams.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: So, it is in our collective interest to not just minimise the risk of scams and such tactics against vulnerable members of the community, but to collectively take action to prevent such cases from happening.
